labels: Seated on a low bench, the student bends toward one shoe, holding opposite lace ends in separate hands above that shoe's eyelets while the other foot supports the pose.; 낮은 벤치에 앉은 학생이 한 구두 쪽으로 숙이고 해당 구두 끈 구멍 위 양쪽 끈 끝을 각각의 손에 쥐며 반대 발로 자세를 받친다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Seated on a low bench, the student bends toward one shoe, holding opposite lace ends in separate hands above that shoe's eyelets while the other foot supports the pose.
aliases: 신발끈 묶기
